items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Wilbur Sweetman, providing no personal connection or interaction details.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, at the Savoy. Ella was with the band. That was a great band, Chick Webb's band at that time. Sandy Williams on trombone, Taft Jordan, Wayman Carver, Elmer Williams, tenor saxophone, Wayman Carver was playing flute. I think Pauley was in that band too for a while. But that was a great band. Chick and Ella, oh goodness, I worked opposite Chick's band up there while I was with Willie Bryant. We worked opposite Chick's band for a year, a year and a half. Benny Carter was in the band then with Willie…
Before we get too much into that, let me ask you one thing about Wilbur Sweetman.
